shared_elements: shallow incised/low-relief carving of motifs on a flat-ish field
justification: Both surfaces carry human-related imagery with a prominent circular disc and horizontal dividing bands, but that is about as generic as shared iconography gets. B shows a specific two-figure encounter in profile flanking an offering stand above ruled registers of sign-writing, whereas A is a frontal, massive, largely three-dimensional figure whose body carries isolated schematic emblems (disc, collar-like arcs) with no narrative scene, no profile figures and no script registers.
